name: Use of coded language, rapid channel migration or deleted campaigns
description: Organiser moves between platforms or handles, closes campaigns and restarts under new names after scrutiny.
fp: May have innocent explanations; assess in context of customer profile and other indicators.

sources.text: FATF, Terrorist Financing Risk Assessment Guidance (2019)
